visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at night on a wet urban street. A young woman with long dark hair, wearing an off-white padded jacket and a beige hoodie, stands before a brightly lit storefront named 'TEEAMO'. She holds a smartphone in her left hand and gestures with her right. The background features classical European architecture and glowing shop signs reflected on the wet pavement. (2) Inside the shop, a digital menu board displays various tea options like 'Assam Milk Tea' and 'Fruit Tea' with prices in Euros. Below, a counter contains several stainless steel containers filled with translucent colorful toppings including orange, red, and yellow pearls. (3) The woman interacts with a male staff member wearing a green t-shirt at the POS counter. She holds currency in her hand while a blue screen displays transaction details. (4) A close-up shot presents two drinks side-by-side: a light brown milk tea with dark pearls and a layered orange-to-yellow fruit drink, both in large plastic cups with white lids. (5) Back outside on the wet sidewalk at night, the woman holds the milk tea cup. Tiny white particles, appearing as light snow or rain, fall around her. She removes the straw from its paper wrapper, inserts it into the lid, and takes a sip. Her facial expressions vary from curiosity to a slight grimace as she chews. Yellow and white text overlays and variety-show style emojis pop up on the screen intermittently. (6) She stands holding both drinks, looking directly into the camera while speaking. The street behind her is filled with pedestrians and city lights, creating a bokeh effect.
